--- docs/design/journal-storage.md (committed 2026-02-11) ---
# Sync journal storage design
Proposal: use SQLite in WAL mode, with the database file on the shared NFS volume so every worker sees the same journal. WAL gives us concurrent readers and a single writer with great crash recovery. This is the recommended direction.

--- docs/ops/journal-growth-runbook.md (2026-04-07, excerpt) ---
JSONL segments grow ~2GB/day under normal load. Compaction runs hourly. If disk alerts fire, check compaction lag first. (Why JSONL? See the 2026-03-19 spike results in .view/runs/.)
